symptom: Run aborts: client X didn't report status for N seconds
root_cause: Slow site silent during its long round exceeds max_status_report_interval
impact: Whole run lost; every other site's epoch discarded
preventive_change: 24 h timeouts committed into the job configs
general_lesson: A timeout tuned on the fastest participant is a policy that excludes the slowest

symptom: NVML: Unknown Error mid-run; the GPU vanishes from the container
root_cause: Daily systemd daemon-reload strips the GPU on cgroup v2 with the systemd Docker driver
impact: Run lost mid-epoch; recurs on a daily timer
preventive_change: scripts/client_node_setup/fix_docker_cgroupfs.sh switches the driver to cgroupfs
general_lesson: Host maintenance the consortium does not control is part of the training system

symptom: Client reports healthy but never registers after a restart
root_cause: Stale daemon_pid.fl lock makes start.sh refuse to launch
impact: Site silently absent from the run
preventive_change: Delete daemon_pid.fl in the kit root before relaunch; documented in the restart runbook
general_lesson: Installed is not running; running is not registered

symptom: A host reboot mid-run triggers the stale lock silently and the run then hangs for a full day
root_cause: Unclean reboot leaves the lock; nothing detects it
impact: ~24 h of consortium time lost per occurrence, twice on the same day
preventive_change: Documented as F3b; reboot detection still open
general_lesson: A silent hang costs more than a loud crash

symptom: Instant crash: OSError: Read-only file system
root_cause: Preprocessing cache written under the read-only /data mount
impact: Fast failure; cheap
preventive_change: Point ODELIA_PREPROCESS_CACHE_DIR under /scratch; added to preflight
general_lesson: The cheapest failures are the ones that happen before the run starts

symptom: Run aborts with MODEL_UNRECOGNIZED from a slow site
root_cause: Swarm advanced a round without the slow site; its late model was then rejected
impact: Run lost
preventive_change: Wait-for-all: min_responses_required = number of clients
general_lesson: Partial progress in a synchronous protocol is not progress

symptom: Run aborts after a node goes deemed disconnected
root_cause: VPN tunnel drop for that site
impact: Run lost; recurs on long multi-epoch rounds
preventive_change: VPN keepalive and a root watchdog timer; wait-for-all bounds the wait by learn_task_timeout
general_lesson: Network reliability requirements grow with round length, not with site count

symptom: DataLoader worker killed by signal: Bus error, shared memory
root_cause: /dev/shm too small for the dataloader workers
impact: Run lost early
preventive_change: --ipc=host set for swarm clients
general_lesson: Container defaults are tuned for services, not for training

symptom: Run trains on a SUBSET and still reports success: clients did not configure within timeout but min_clients=N allows proceeding
root_cause: Controller stops waiting once configure_min_clients have answered; a site whose job cell is seconds slower receives the p2p key_exchange before its child cell exists
impact: A 7-site benchmark silently became a 5-site benchmark; the dropped sites are the slowest, which on a real consortium are the largest
preventive_change: Set configure_min_clients = participating site count for every benchmark run
general_lesson: A resilience default becomes a correctness bug the moment the run is a benchmark

symptom: Site absent from check_status server while its container reports Up N weeks (healthy)
root_cause: Startup kit from an older provisioning generation; TLS handshake rejected by a superseded root
impact: A site believed itself connected and contributed nothing for three weeks
preventive_change: Verify the expected site count in check_status server after every kit roll-out
general_lesson: A health check that does not check the thing that matters is worse than none

symptom: cross_val_results.json is {} although the server logged Published metrics for 8 site(s)
root_cause: Two components act on the same END_RUN; ValidationJsonGenerator writes the file before the later-listed collector publishes into it
impact: Per-site results never left the hospitals; blocked D2.5, D3.3 and the privacy work
preventive_change: Publish on ABOUT_TO_END_RUN, which fires strictly earlier, so the result no longer depends on config ordering
general_lesson: When one component consumes what another produces, do not let config order decide

symptom: Per-site table ranked one centre worst on macro AUROC
root_cause: Macro AUROC averaged a benign one-vs-rest figure computed from 2 positive cases; the ordering tracked benign support almost exactly
impact: A centre was described as underperforming on a split artefact. Excluding that class it moves 0.602 to 0.717, another 0.710 to 0.908
preventive_change: Every metric travels with its per-class support; no ranking on macro where a class has single-digit support
general_lesson: A summary statistic computed over a class that barely exists is not a measurement

symptom: A checkpoint loaded with the wrong architecture fails silently
root_cause: best_FL_global_model.pt evaluated with a different --model-name; weights load partially and produce plausible numbers
impact: An entire evaluation was invalid and looked fine
preventive_change: Read train_conf out of the checkpoint and check it against --model-name before evaluating; warm-start provenance guard
general_lesson: Silence is the most expensive failure mode in machine learning

symptom: Pooled accuracy 0.752 alongside malignant AUROC 0.887 looked acceptable
root_cause: Accuracy hides the operating point; the threshold was not where the AUROC suggested
impact: A model with poor malignant recall reads as adequate
preventive_change: Report malignant recall alongside accuracy
general_lesson: Discrimination and calibration are different questions and accuracy answers neither

symptom: Three in-house test runs lost; transfers extremely slow
root_cause: Peer traffic routed through the coordinating server; the two test machines reach each other in 1 ms but the server is in another city, so Tailscale falls back to a DERP relay. A 700 MB model crossed the country twice per round
impact: Three runs lost; initially misread as a platform defect
preventive_change: Diagnosed and documented; topology fix open
general_lesson: Measure the path, not the endpoints

symptom: Deploy test collided with the production server; symptom looked like a stale startup kit
root_cause: The two-node deploy test shared both project name AND ports (8002/8003) with the production server
impact: Misdiagnosis cost hours; risk of disturbing production
preventive_change: Moved the test project to ports 8102/8103
general_lesson: A test that shares a namespace with production is a production change

symptom: A broken metric path survived two live eight-site runs with green CI
root_cause: pytest.importorskip('nvflare') skipped the collector's entire test file because the workflow never installed NVFlare
impact: Two consortium runs produced no usable per-site results
preventive_change: Workflow now installs the in-tree fork; tests run and are visible by name
general_lesson: A skipped test file reports the same green as a passing one

symptom: Four tests in test_partner_handbook_is_real.py have never run
root_cause: Skip guard points at docs/consortium/PARTNER_HANDBOOK.md which does not exist; the handbooks are .docx under untracked workspace/
impact: The check that partner-facing docker.sh flags still exist has never executed
preventive_change: Proposed: fail CI on unexpected skips with an allowlist
general_lesson: The fourth recurrence of the same class of defect is a process problem, not a coding problem

symptom: validate-swarm reported fail repeatedly on unrelated PRs
root_cause: Job-level concurrency group keeps at most one PENDING job; a third arrival evicts the queued one. gh renders cancelled identically to fail
impact: Wasted reruns; one wrong diagnosis recorded about a dependabot PR
preventive_change: Proposed: drop the job-level group and rely on the existing host_gpu_lock.sh, which blocks rather than evicting
general_lesson: Never present cancelled and failed to a human the same way

symptom: Four of eight recorded site join dates were wrong by ~6 weeks
root_cause: April records came from internal test machines running under hospital site names on pre-release kits
impact: A published chart misstated when the consortium formed
preventive_change: Site attribution now resolved from heartbeat.json hostname, not the configured site name
general_lesson: A site name in a config is a label, not an identity

symptom: A site's benign count was rendered as blank rather than zero
root_cause: Class absent from the counts dict was treated as missing data
impact: A real finding (one site holds no benign cases at all) read as a gap in the record
preventive_change: Absent class recorded as 0, not blank
general_lesson: Absence of a class is data; absence of a record is not

symptom: Byzantine-robust aggregation rules cost 0.40 relative error before any attacker is present
root_cause: Trimmed mean, median and Krum cannot honour contribution weights, so they target the unweighted mean of site optima. Benign is 40.9% of pooled data but 20.4% of the average site because one site holds 83.9% of all benign cases
impact: The textbook defence would halve the consortium's effective evidence
preventive_change: Recommend norm-bounding, which keeps weights; do not adopt order-statistic rules
general_lesson: Methods that assume exchangeable participants do not transfer to real consortia

symptom: Uncertainty sampling found FEWER malignant cases than random at every labelling budget
root_cause: Accuracy does not rise with confidence at all: the 0.5-0.6 confidence bin is 0.786 accurate while the more confident 0.6-0.7 bin is 0.250 (z=3.48, p=0.0005). Temperature scaling fitted on a held-out split improved ECE 0.180 to 0.128 and changed nothing about acquisition
impact: The uncertainty family of acquisition rules cannot work for this model, and no post-hoc rescaling repairs it, because the ranking rather than the scale carries the defect
preventive_change: Recorded as E4; scripts/calibration/analyse_calibration.py tests the reliability inversion for significance rather than asserting it
general_lesson: Miscalibration is a monotone curve in the wrong place and rescaling fixes it; a non-monotone curve means the ranking carries no signal and nothing post-hoc repairs a ranking
